_note: Co-op chat on screen. max_lines = lines shown at once; line_seconds = how long a line stays; fade_seconds = the last seconds of that it fades over; nearby_radius = world units a 'nearby' line carries; inbox_max = lines the net layer keeps until the app takes them; open_key = the letter that opens the input box; input_max = characters the box takes (80 at most); history_max = lines remembered, open_lines = lines shown while the box is open; rate_lines per rate_window_seconds is the host's limit for one guest, then cooldown_seconds of silence; name_colors = sender name colours (r, g, b), picked by peer id; ping_seconds = how long a quick-chat map ping lasts (it fades over all of it); bubble_seconds and bubble_max_chars = how long and how long a line the speech bubble over a speaker shows; said_recently_max = names in the pause menu SAID RECENTLY list.
